description: Update fields on ONE storage path (PATCH — only fields you supply are changed). Editable fields: name, path (path template), match (matching pattern), matching_algorithm, is_insensitive. To assign this storage path to documents, use edit_documents_bulk with method 'set_storage_path' or update_document instead.

matching_algorithm.description: Matching algorithm: 0=None, 1=Any word, 2=All words, 3=Exact match, 4=Regular expression, 5=Fuzzy word, 6=Automatic
